fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UsedTruck/BuyUsedTrucks.cy.js#UsedTruck - BuyUsedTrucks [en] — Buy Used Trucks TC-BUT-03: Contact Seller lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Buy Used Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BUT-03
**Title:** Contact Seller lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Buy Used Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Buy Used Trucks page, open Contact Seller, fill a valid name, an invalid (5-digit) mobile number, and leave city empty, then submit.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown mobile-format and location-required validation messages are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Buy Used Trucks page
2. Open the Contact Seller lead form from a visible card
3. Fill a valid name and an invalid mobile number
4. Submit with city left empty
5. Verify the mobile-format and location validation messages are shown
